standard.question: The frozen scope rule (p1/t1_channelA_wip/POLICY.md): an event is an open-end mutual fund -> ETF conversion or reorganisation, including acquisition of a MF by an existing ETF. MF->MF, ETF->ETF, CEF and acquiring-ETF-prospectus-only are NOT events. Every gate reason in this pool asks the same thing: is the TARGET an open-end mutual fund?
promote_if: S1 — the excerpt states the target is a mutual fund or an open-end management investment company ('currently operates as a mutual fund', 'from a mutual fund into', 'a mutual fund series of')

S2 — the excerpt names two or more retail share classes OF THE TARGET (Class A/C/F/I/R/Z, Institutional/Investor/Advisor Shares, 'all share classes of each Acquired Fund'), which a closed-end fund and an ETF do not have
S3 — the filing is a supplement to the TARGET's own Summary Prospectus / statutory Prospectus, i.e. Form N-1A disclosure, which only an open-end fund files
S4 — the excerpt directs holders to exchange into another mutual fund of the same complex, placing the target inside an open-end complex
reject_if: D1 — the acquiring fund offers multiple share classes, so the destination is a mutual fund (MF->MF)
D2 — the excerpt describes the target as an ETF (ETF->ETF)
standard.otherwise: UNRESOLVED. Meta-rule 4: don't know -> stop. An unresolved row is NOT promoted and NOT deleted; it stays visible in the register with the reason.
standard.note: Every `quote` below is verified to appear verbatim in the cited accession's committed excerpt by resolve_recheck.py, which refuses to emit an overlay if any quote is absent. That check is what separates this from an assertion.
